scope: Approved single product.season_ids array; existing SKU/barcode/nine-price rules unchanged; image writes use a separately frozen contract.

routes.result: Existing candidate DTO. Individual native season dictionary entries; no combination entries.
Existing COMMITTED receipt DTO; original key and actor namespace shared across v1/v2.

values.name: string
values.seasonIds: CREATE: UUID[]; EDIT: UUID[]|null; required own property
values.prices: All nine existing product price keys required, each canonical money string|null. No SKU prices.
values.removedFromV2: seasonId is forbidden as an extra property; legacy scalar is not writable or returned in v2.values.

seasons.null: Historical UNKNOWN. EDIT null only when actual stored season_ids is already NULL. F2 must preserve unchanged unknown, not default it to [].
seasons.empty: Explicit known empty/clear. Valid CREATE or EDIT; no fake mandatory-single-season rule.
seasons.selected: Canonical lowercase UUID array. Reject duplicates, NULL elements, nested arrays, invalid UUIDs and missing dictionaries. Normalize UUID order only after validation; equal sets are equal requests/no season change.
seasons.references: references.seasons:[{id:UUID,name:string}] replaces references.season. Dictionary display_order,id order; exactly actual selected members. NULL and [] both references.seasons=[]; values.seasonIds carries the distinction.
seasons.editLegacyScalar: Existing product.season_id retained exactly, never assigned from first array member.
seasons.readLabel: Existing drawer/list seasonLabel remains string|null. Batch dictionary aggregation with '、'; no DTO change to frozen drawer.
seasons.filters: Existing filter.seasonIds nonempty ANY-overlap; empty unrestricted. Unique product count and stock totals; authorization scope applied before candidate expansion.
seasons.sizePolicy: No new business cap; existing HTTP body bound. Invalid arrays reject whole request, never truncate.

children: skus and barcodes retain W2 exact fields, CAS and immutable identity/raw-barcode rules.
transactions: One PRODUCT root CAS, original request key, D1 prepare BEFORE root/children mutation, complete after writes. season_ids is actual root before/after JSON, not child-table audit.
idempotency: v2 CREATE/EDIT hashes include explicit contractVersion:2 and canonical array, preventing cross-contract key reuse. Status commands share old canonical hash. Old committed v1 CREATE/EDIT retries recover only exact original hash/current permission before upgrade rejection. HTTP 500/unknown commit: query original receipt, do not invent a new key.

compatibility.unverified: v2 returns503 PRODUCT_SEASON_NOT_READY. Existing EXACT19 list/detail reads retain legacy SQL; no new-column probe or catch/fallback. Existing v1 maintenance preserved only before verified activation.
compatibility.verified: Old /products/commands CREATE/EDIT without existing matching receipt and old /products/maintenance/detail/query return409 PRODUCT_EDIT_CONTRACT_UPGRADE_REQUIRED. Existing status commands and receipt recovery continue.
compatibility.activation: D1 verifies actual column/checks/two-way season reference guards/runtime ACL and conversion, issues target-bound synchronous capability. Constructor flag/version alone is not proof. C activates frontend and backend together.

errors.common: Existing 401/403/404/413 and sanitized500 remain; no DB detail/paths leaked.

providerSeam.definition: ProductSeasonArrayCapability {profile:'product-season-array-v1';assertVerified(target:object):void}, exported beside existing retained-delete capability in adapters/postgres/src/product-query-reader.ts
providerSeam.readers: Optional third constructor argument; exact actual pool passed to synchronous verifier; missing capability keeps legacy SQL.
providerSeam.writer: PostgresProductMaintenanceUnitOfWork options.seasonCapability; exact D1 driver object passed to synchronous verifier; verified instance exposes readonly seasonContract:'product-season-array-v1' to application.
providerSeam.issuer: D1 only. Reject malformed object/getters/async verifier/nonvoid result. D1 verifier must reject any different/unverified target; capability creation is not implemented by D2.

statusEvidence: Contract frozen only. No schema, real PG, startup, production conversion, browser or deployment validation claimed.
